'''Kerrin''' was an individual who worked at [[Gravity Hook Seven]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. His colleague known only as [[Z (individual)|Z]] found out that Kerrin had almost managed to wipe the facility's [[GH7 security matrix computer]]s, and wanted to boot Kerrin out of the docking ring airlock for the mistake.
